FEAT-6-S100.title: Consent Data Model and API Contract Definition
FEAT-6-S100.description: Define Pydantic models and internal data schemas for consent tiers, consent status, audit metadata, and storage decisions. Establish clear input/output contracts for consent evaluation and enforcement used across services and tool_router.

FEAT-6-S101.title: Consent API Endpoints and Tool Router Exposure
FEAT-6-S101.description: Expose consent workflow functionality via FastAPI endpoints and tool_router integration. Ensure consent capture, tier escalation, and status retrieval are callable by the LLM tool-use loop with proper validation and allowlisting (GOV-004).

FEAT-6-S102.title: Consent Workflow Unit and Integration Test Suite
FEAT-6-S102.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating consent tier transitions, de-identification enforcement, and cross-service propagation. Include edge cases such as missing consent, downgrade attempts, and partial PHI detection.
